findings.scenario: Observe whether Growth in disaster losses, protection gaps, uninsurability, disaster-linked debt stress, and repeated service interruption moves in the direction of concern: Losses and protection gaps rising faster than resilience investment or recovery capacity
findings.observationCadence: quarterly signal scan and annual GAR refresh
findings.measurableTrigger: A dependency appears in multiple high-ranked risks or repeated disasters expose the same recovery bottleneck
findings.boundedResponse: Model critical dependency chains and run bounded tabletop failure sequences using public data
findings.rollback: Remove unverified dependencies and reset scenarios to the last reproducible model version
findings.authorityBoundary: Automation owns public-data modeling and sandboxed exercises. Financial transactions, insurance decisions, emergency operations, and third-party coordination need separately classified authority; escalate only a substantiated nonautomatable barrier.
